title: How to Talk About Your Daily Routine | Stop Translating in Your Head | English Podcast Ep.2

subtitles.en:
Hello everyone! Welcome back to AB English
Podcast... I'm Mia!
subtitles.zh: 大家哈囉！歡迎回到英語廣播節目，我是 Mia！

subtitles.en:
And I'm Alex! It's so great to be here with
all of you today.
subtitles.zh: 我是 Alex！今天能和大家聚在這裡真是太棒了。

subtitles.en: So, how are you doing today, Alex?
subtitles.zh: 那麼，Alex，你今天過得如何呀？

subtitles.en:
Well, I'm good... but honestly, I am still a
little bit sleepy.
subtitles.zh: 嗯，我還算好啦……但說老實話，我現在還是有點睏。

subtitles.en:
Haha, you definitely look tired! Did you stay
up late last night?
subtitles.zh: 哈哈，你看起來真的超累的！你昨晚熬夜了嗎？

subtitles.en:
Yeah... I was watching this really good
movie, and I didn't go to bed until 2 AM!
subtitles.zh: 對啊……我在看一部超精彩的電影，結果直到凌晨兩點才睡！

subtitles.en:
Oh no! Well, no wonder you look completely
exhausted.
subtitles.zh: 天哪！難怪你看起來整個人都快累垮了。

subtitles.en:
I know... waking up this morning was just—so
difficult.
subtitles.zh: 我知道……今天早上起床簡直痛苦得要命。

subtitles.en:
Well, that actually leads perfectly into our
topic today!
subtitles.zh: 好啦，這正好完美切入我們今天的主題！

subtitles.en:
That's right! Today, we're going to talk
about... "Daily Routines".
subtitles.zh: 沒錯！今天我們要聊的就是……「日常作息」。

subtitles.en:
We'll share how we start our day, our work
habits... and how we unwind and relax!
subtitles.zh: 我們會分享自己如何展開新的一天、工作習慣……還有平時如何放鬆身心！

subtitles.en:
Exactly. Talking about your daily routine is
really the best way to practice speaking
naturally.
subtitles.zh: 確實如此。聊聊日常作息真的是練習自然開口說話的最佳方式。

subtitles.en:
Because it's something you do... every single
day!
subtitles.zh: 沒錯，因為這就是你每一天都在做的事情啊！

subtitles.en:
So Mia, let's start with the morning—how does
your day begin?
subtitles.zh: 那麼 Mia，我們就從早晨開始吧——妳的一天是怎麼開始的？

subtitles.en:
Okay! But first... what is the very first
thing you do when you wake up?
subtitles.zh: 好啊！但先說說你吧……你起床後做的第一件事是什麼？

subtitles.en:
Oh, I hit the snooze button... at least three
times!
subtitles.zh: 噢，我會狂按貪睡鬧鐘……至少按三次！

subtitles.en:
Three times?! Wow, so you are definitely not
an early bird.
subtitles.zh: 三次？！哇，那你絕對不是晨型人呢。

subtitles.en:
No way! I am a total night owl... I honestly
hate mornings.
subtitles.zh: 怎麼可能！我是個徹頭徹尾的夜貓子……老實說我討厭早晨。

subtitles.en:
Haha, see, I'm an early bird! I wake up at
six-thirty every single day.
subtitles.zh: 哈哈，看吧，我就是早起一族！我每天早上六點半就會起床。

subtitles.en:
Six-thirty?! That is crazy! Do you even use
an alarm?
subtitles.zh: 六點半？！太瘋狂了吧！妳還需要設鬧鐘嗎？

subtitles.en:
Yes, but honestly... I usually wake up right
before my alarm goes off.
subtitles.zh: 會呀，不過老實說……我通常在鬧鐘響起前就自然醒了。

subtitles.en: Wow... I am so jealous of you.
subtitles.zh: 哇……我真是太羨慕妳了。

subtitles.en:
So, once you finally drag yourself out of
bed... what do you do next?
subtitles.zh: 那當你終於把自己拖下床後，接下來會做什麼呢？

subtitles.en:
Well, I drag myself to the bathroom, brush my
teeth, and splash cold water on my face.
subtitles.zh: 嗯，我會把自己拖進浴室、刷刷牙，然後用冷水潑潑臉提神。

subtitles.en: And do you eat breakfast?
subtitles.zh: 那你會吃早餐嗎？

subtitles.en:
No, I never have time! I just grab a huge cup
of coffee.
subtitles.zh: 不，我根本沒時間！我都直接灌一大杯黑咖啡。

subtitles.en:
Just coffee?! Oh, that's really not good for
your stomach.
subtitles.zh: 只喝咖啡？！天哪，那樣對你的胃很不好耶。

subtitles.en:
I know, I know... but I literally can't
function without it! How about you?
subtitles.zh: 我知道、我知道……但沒咖啡我整個人根本無法運轉啊！那妳呢？

subtitles.en:
Well, I always drink a tall glass of warm
water first.
subtitles.zh: 嗯，我第一件事總是先喝一大杯溫開水。

subtitles.en:
Warm water? Hmm... that sounds really
healthy.
subtitles.zh: 溫開水？嗯……聽起來真養生。

subtitles.en:
Yes! And then, I do some light stretching for
about ten minutes.
subtitles.zh: 對呀！然後我會做大約十分鐘的輕度伸展操。

subtitles.en: And do you actually make breakfast?
subtitles.zh: 那妳真的會親自做早餐嗎？

subtitles.en:
Yes! I usually make oatmeal topped with fresh
fruit.
subtitles.zh: 會啊！我通常會煮燕麥粥，搭配新鮮水果。

subtitles.en:
Wow... you have such a perfect morning
routine!
subtitles.zh: 哇……妳的早晨生活作息也太完美了吧！

subtitles.en:
And then, after breakfast... well, it's time
for work.
subtitles.zh: 吃完早餐之後……嗯，就該準備去上班了。

subtitles.en: So how do you get to work, Mia? Do you drive?
subtitles.zh: 那妳都怎麼去上班，Mia？妳自己開車嗎？

subtitles.en:
Oh no, I don't even own a car. I just take
the bus.
subtitles.zh: 噢沒有，我根本沒買車。我都搭公車。

subtitles.en: Oh really? How long does that take?
subtitles.zh: 真的喔？那要花多久時間？

subtitles.en: Hmm... it usually takes about thirty minutes.
subtitles.zh: 嗯……通常大概要花三十分鐘左右。

subtitles.en:
And what do you do on the bus? Do you catch
up on sleep?
subtitles.zh: 那妳在公車上都在做什麼？補眠嗎？

subtitles.en:
No, not at all! I usually just read a book...
or listen to some music.
subtitles.zh: 才不會呢！我通常只是看看書……或是聽點音樂。

subtitles.en: Well, that sounds really nice and relaxing.
subtitles.zh: 嗯，聽起來真的很愜意又放鬆。

subtitles.en: What about you, Alex? How's your commute?
subtitles.zh: 那你呢，Alex？你平常通勤都怎麼樣？

subtitles.en: Oh, I take the subway. It's... always packed.
subtitles.zh: 唉，我都搭捷運。每次都……擠得要命。

subtitles.en:
Ugh, I hate crowded subways. It just makes me
feel so stressed out.
subtitles.zh: 呃，我最討厭擠捷運了。光用想的就讓人壓力好大。

subtitles.en:
Me too! But... well, I listen to podcasts to
learn new things.
subtitles.zh: 我也是！不過……嗯，我會聽播客節目來學點新東西。

subtitles.en: Oh, that's a fantastic way to use your time!
subtitles.zh: 噢，這真是善用時間的絕佳方法！

subtitles.en:
Yeah. And then, I arrive at the office right
around 9 AM.
subtitles.zh: 是啊。然後差不多早上九點左右抵達辦公室。

subtitles.en:
So, what's the very first thing you do once
you get there?
subtitles.zh: 那你一進辦公室，第一件事情都做什麼？

subtitles.en:
Hmm, I check my emails... and plan out my
tasks for the day.
subtitles.zh: 嗯……我會收個信，然後規劃一下今天一整天的工作事項。

subtitles.en: Good organization is so important.
subtitles.zh: 有條理的規劃真的很重要。

subtitles.en: Alright, let's fast forward to the evening!
subtitles.zh: 好啦，那我們把時間快轉到傍晚吧！

subtitles.en: What time do you usually wrap up work?
subtitles.zh: 你通常都幾點下班啊？

subtitles.en: Well, I usually get off work around 6 PM.
subtitles.zh: 嗯，我通常大約傍晚六點左右下班。

subtitles.en: And what do you do after work?
subtitles.zh: 那你下班後都做些什麼？

subtitles.en: Sometimes I hit the gym to work out.
subtitles.zh: 有時候我會去健身房流流汗、運動一下。

subtitles.en: Oh! Wow, I didn't know you liked working out!
subtitles.zh: 喔！哇，我都不知道你原來喜歡健身！

subtitles.en:
Yeah, I try to go about three times a week.
It really... clears my head.
subtitles.zh: 對啊，我盡量維持一週去三次。這真的能……讓腦袋清醒不少。

subtitles.en:
That's awesome. Do you usually cook dinner
afterward?
subtitles.zh: 那太棒了。那你運動完會自己煮晚餐嗎？

subtitles.en:
Honestly? Mostly no. I usually just grab
takeout on my way home.
subtitles.zh: 老實說嗎？大多不會。我通常只是在回家路上順便買外帶。

subtitles.en:
Ah, well... takeout is convenient, but it
gets expensive!
subtitles.zh: 啊，也是啦……外帶是很方便沒錯，但累積下來花費挺驚人的！

subtitles.en:
Tell me about it! What about you, Mia—do you
cook your own meals?
subtitles.zh: 可不是嘛！那妳呢，Mia——妳平時會自己做飯嗎？

subtitles.en:
Yes, I love cooking! It's super therapeutic
for me.
subtitles.zh: 會啊，我超愛做菜的！對我來說非常療癒放鬆。

subtitles.en:
Look at you, so healthy! So... what do you do
after dinner?
subtitles.zh: 瞧瞧妳，生活真健康！那……妳吃飽飯後都做些什麼？

subtitles.en:
Well, I take a long shower, and then... I
binge-watch some shows.
subtitles.zh: 嗯，我會好好洗個澡，然後……痛快追劇看影片。

subtitles.en:
Nice! What kind of shows do you usually
watch?
subtitles.zh: 讚喔！那妳通常都看哪種類型的劇？

subtitles.en:
I love comedies! They always make me laugh
out loud.
subtitles.zh: 我最愛喜劇了！每次都把我逗得哈哈大笑。

subtitles.en:
Ah, for me... evenings are strictly reserved
for video games.
subtitles.zh: 啊，換作是我……晚上的時間絕對是專門留給打電動的。

subtitles.en: Really? Do you play solo or with friends?
subtitles.zh: 真的假的？你是自己一個人玩，還是跟朋友一起？

subtitles.en:
I hop online with my buddies. Honestly, it's
my favorite part of the day.
subtitles.zh: 我都跟好哥們在線上連線玩。老實說，這是我一整天最期待的時光了。

subtitles.en:
And let me guess... then you finally go to
bed at 2 AM!
subtitles.zh: 然後讓我猜猜……接著你就一路玩到半夜兩點才睡！

subtitles.en: Haha, spot on! The endless cycle continues.
subtitles.zh: 哈哈，完全被妳說中了！這無限循環每天都在上演。

subtitles.en:
But what about the weekends? Are they totally
different?
subtitles.zh: 不過到了週末呢？生活步調會完全不一樣嗎？

subtitles.en:
Oh, entirely different! On Saturdays... I
sleep in!
subtitles.zh: 噢，那差可多了！星期六這天……我一定要睡到自然醒！

subtitles.en:
Really? What time do you actually roll out of
bed on a Saturday?
subtitles.zh: 真的假的？那你星期六通常幾點才肯爬起來？

subtitles.en: Well... sometimes not until 11 AM!
subtitles.zh: 這個嘛……有時候會一路賴到早上十一點！

subtitles.en: Wow! Even on weekends, I'm up by 7 AM.
subtitles.zh: 哇！我就算放假，也都是早上七點就醒了耶。

subtitles.en:
Man, you're unstoppable! So what do you even
do all weekend?
subtitles.zh: 天啊，妳簡直精力充沛！那妳週末一整天都在幹嘛？

subtitles.en:
Well, I usually tackle my chores—you know,
doing laundry, deep cleaning the apartment...
subtitles.zh: 嗯，我通常都在做家事——像是洗洗衣服、把整間公寓好好打掃乾淨……

subtitles.en: Oof... that sounds like way too much work.
subtitles.zh: 哎唷……聽起來未免也太累了吧。

subtitles.en:
It is, but... well, I really like having a
clean home. And then—I meet my friends for
coffee!
subtitles.zh:
確實是這樣，不過……嗯，我真的很喜歡家裡乾乾淨淨的。
然後呢——我就會去跟朋友喝杯咖啡！

subtitles.en:
Oh, I love catching up with friends too! We
usually... well, go to the movies.
subtitles.zh: 噢，我也超喜歡跟朋友聚聚的！我們通常……嗯，會一起去看場電影。

subtitles.en:
Weekends really are the absolute best time to
recharge...
subtitles.zh: 週末真的就是好好充電充電的最佳時光了……

subtitles.en:
Well... we certainly shared a lot about our
daily routines today!
subtitles.zh: 好啦……我們今天確實分享了不少各自的日常生活作息呢！

subtitles.en:
Yes, we did! Mornings, work, evenings... and
weekends!
subtitles.zh: 沒錯！從早晨時光、上班工作、夜晚放鬆……一路聊到了週末！

subtitles.en: And now—it's your turn to practice!
subtitles.zh: 現在——輪到你們來練習囉！

subtitles.en: Here is our Daily Challenge for you today...
subtitles.zh: 這就是我們今天為大家準備的「每日挑戰」……

subtitles.en:
Tell us down in the comments: are you an
early bird... or a night owl?
subtitles.zh: 請在下方留言告訴我們：你到底是個晨型人……還是夜貓子呢？

subtitles.en:
And tell us just one thing... that you do
every single morning!
subtitles.zh: 還有，告訴我們一件……你每天早晨都一定會做的事吧！

subtitles.en:
Try to write your answer in English! We
promise... we'll read your comments!
subtitles.zh: 試著用英文寫下你的答案吧！我們保證……一定會親自看大家的留言喔！

subtitles.en:
Oh, and before we go... we have a very
special message for our new listeners!
subtitles.zh: 噢，在節目結束前……我們有一段特別的話想對新聽眾說！

subtitles.en:
First—remember that every single video has
highly accurate subtitles in twenty-nine
languages!
subtitles.zh: 第一點——請記得我們的每支影片都配有高達二十九種語言的超精準字幕！

subtitles.en:
So turn on your native language subtitles...
and learn with absolutely zero stress!
subtitles.zh: 所以快打開你的母語字幕……零壓力輕鬆學英文吧！

subtitles.en:
Second—we really want you to practice what
you learned today!
subtitles.zh: 第二點——我們非常希望你能把今天學到的內容實際練習一遍！

subtitles.en:
You can use our completely free GugoPro
Dictation Player!
subtitles.zh: 你可以使用我們完全免費的 GugoPro 聽寫播放器！

subtitles.en:
Just listen sentence by sentence... and check
your pronunciation right with your
microphone.
subtitles.zh: 只要跟著逐句聆聽……就能直接用麥克風檢查你的發音喔。

subtitles.en:
And wow, you can also use our AI Speaking
Tutor to practice one-on-one conversations!
subtitles.zh: 哇，你甚至還能使用我們的 AI 口說家教，進行一對一的對話練習呢！

subtitles.en:
All the links are in the description below...
and yes, they're completely free!
subtitles.zh: 所有的連結都在下方資訊欄裡……沒錯，通通完全免費！

subtitles.en:
If you enjoyed this video... please hit that
like button and subscribe!
subtitles.zh: 如果你喜歡這支影片的話……請幫我們按個讚並訂閱頻道喔！

subtitles.en: Thank you so much for learning with us today!
subtitles.zh: 非常感謝大家今天跟我們一起學習！

subtitles.en: And remember...
subtitles.zh: 永遠要記得……

subtitles.en: Always... better... everyday!
subtitles.zh: 每一天……都要……超越昨天的自己！

subtitles.en: See you next time! Bye-bye!
subtitles.zh: 我們下次見囉！掰掰！

subtitles.en: Bye, everyone!
subtitles.zh: 大家掰掰！
